scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/db/migrations && cp src/db/migrations/*.sql dist/db/migrations/
scripts.test: npm run build && node --env-file=.env --import tsx test/require-test-database.ts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && tsx --test test/app.test.ts test/items.unit.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --env-file=.env --import tsx test/require-test-database.ts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test test/*.integration.test.ts
